quote: We instruction-tune DocLLM on a variety of instructions curated from multiple DocAI datasets using templates. We employ a total of 16 datasets with their corresponding OCRs, spanning four DocAI tasks: Visual Question Answering, Natural Language Inference, Key Information Extraction and Document Classification.
We introduced DocLLM, a lightweight extension to traditional LLMs, tailored for generative reasoning over documents with rich layouts.
outputs: Text answers to prompts, including values for keys, document classifications, yes/no responses, and extracted information.
Generated answers to visual question answering, key information extraction, document classification, and natural language inference tasks over visually rich documents.

quote: Metrics. Following previous work, we evaluate all VQA datasets using Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS), with the exception of VisualMRC, for which we use CIDEr and WTQ, for which we use accuracy. Performance on all CLS and NLI datasets is measured using accuracy. We evaluate all KIE datasets with the F1 score.
